questions.question: A wheel makes 1000 revolutions in covering a distance of 44 km. Find the radius of the wheel.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

No. of revolutions = 1000 revolutions 

Covered distance = 44 km

**Formula:**

Circumference of a wheel = 2πr

Where, r = radius

**Concept used:

 ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/166b5e5f769f22e646ecfada9976c9ef4adc174ca3ceca54991eafe2a6a360d8.png] 

In one revolution, the wheel covers its circumference.

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

⇒ 2πr × 1000 = 44000

⇒ 2πr = 44

​⇒ 2 × 22/7 × r = 44

⇒ 44/7 × r = 44

​⇒ r = 7m

**∴ The radius of the wheel is 7 m.**

questions.question: What is the single discount equivalent to three successive discounts 10%, 15% and 20%?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Multiplying Factors for 10%, 15%, and 20% discounts are 0.9, 0.85, and 0.8.

Combined Multiplying Factor = 0.9 × 0.85 × 0.8 = 0.9 × 0.68 = 0.612

Equivalent Single Discount = 1 − 0.612 = 0.388

**∴ The correct option is C.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: Successive discounts d₁ = 10%, d₂ = 15%, d₃ = 20%

Formula: Net Selling Price = MP × (1 − d₁/100) × (1 − d₂/100) × (1 − d₃/100)

Selling Price = Marked Price × (100 − D₁)/100 × (100 − D₂)/100 × ... where Dₙ are successive discount percentages.</p

questions.question: A and B can do a work in 30 and 40 days respectively. They began the work together. A left the work after some days and B finished the remaining work in 5 days. After how many days did A leave?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Work = LCM(30, 40) = 120 units.

Efficiency of A = 120 ÷ 30 = 4 units/day, Efficiency of B = 120 ÷ 40 = 3 units/day.

Work done by B alone in the last 5 days = 5 × 3 = 15 units.

Remaining work done by A and B together = 120 − 15 = 105 units.

Days A and B worked together = 105 ÷ (4 + 3) = 15 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 15 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by A to complete the work = 30 days

Time taken by B to complete the work = 40 days

B finishes the remaining work alone in 5 days.

**Method Used:**

LCM Method for Time & Work: Total Work is assumed as the LCM of the given days, and efficiency is calculated as Total Work ÷ Days.

 
 

 **Person**

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total work = 120 units

⇒ Efficiency of B = 3 units/day

⇒ Work done by B in the last 5 days = 5 × 3 = 15 units

⇒ Work done by A and B together before A left = Total Work − Work done by B alone

⇒ Work done together = 120 − 15 = 105 units

⇒ Combined efficiency of A and B = 4 + 3 = 7 units/day

⇒ Number of days A and B worked together = 105 ÷ 7 = 15 days

⇒ This implies A left after 15 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 15 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Pipes & Cisterns

This concept is identical to Time and Work. An inlet pipe filling a tank represents positive work, while an outlet pipe emptying the tank represents negative work.

Work & Wages

Wages are distributed strictly in the ratio of the total work done by each individual. If all individuals work for the exact same number of days, their wages are distributed in the ratio of their efficiencies.

Alternate Days Work

When workers perform tasks on alternate days, find the total work completed in one full cycle (e.g., 2 days) and scale it up to reach close to the total work without exceeding it.

questions.question: The ratio of two numbers is 3 ∶ 8. On adding 8 to both the numbers, the ratio becomes 2 ∶ 5. What is the sum of the numbers?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Ratio of two numbers = 3 ∶ 8 

Adding 8 to both numbers, the new ratio = 2 ∶ 5.

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

(3x + 8) / (8x + 8) = 2/5

⇒ 15x + 40 = 16x + 16

⇒ 16x - 15x = 40 - 16

⇒ x = 24

Sum of the number = (3x + 8x) = 11x 

⇒ 11 × 24 = 264

**∴ Sum of the number is 264.**

questions.question: I walk at a speed of 10 km/h and cover a distance in 2 hours. If I increase my speed by 5 km/h, how early would I reach my destination?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Walking speed = 10 km/h 

Covered distance = 2 hours 

If walking speed increased by 5 km/h.

**Formula:**

Distance = Speed × Time 

**Calculation:**

Total distance = 10 × 2 = 20 km

Now,

Speed after increased by 5 = 10 + 5 = 15 km/h

So, new time to cover the same distance 

⇒ (20\15) × 60 = 80 minutes

So, time will be deducted = 120 - 80 = 40 minutes.

**∴ I would reach my destination 40 minutes early.**

questions.question: Rakhi offers a discount of 30% on all the items at her shop and still makes a profit of 12%. What is the cost price (in ₹) of an article marked at ₹280?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Offered a discount = 30% 

Profit = 12%

Market price of the article = Rs 280

**Formula:**

If a shopkeeper wants a profit of R% after allowing a discount of r%,

CP = Market price × (100-r)/(100+R)

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

Cost price = 280 × (100 - 30) / (100 + 12)

⇒ 280 × (70/112)

⇒ 280 × (10/16)

⇒ Rs 175

**∴ The cost price of the article is Rs. 175.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

Profit is calculated on cost price and discount is calculated on market price

questions.question: A man bought some toys at the rate of 12 for ₹48 and sold them at the rate of 8 for ₹48. Find his gain or loss percentage.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Bought some toys at the rate of 12 for Rs. 48 

Sold them at the rate of 8 for Rs. 48

**Formula:**

SP = CP + Profit

Profit = CP × (Profit percentage / 100)

**Calculation:**

CP of each toy = (48 / 12) = Rs 4

SP of each toy = (48 / 8) = Rs. 6

Profit = 6 - 4 = Rs. 2

So, the profit percentage = (2/4) × 100 = 50%

**∴ His gain percentage is 50%**

questions.question: A man sold three-fifth of his articles at a gain of 16% and the remaining at the cost price. Find the gain earned by him in the whole transaction
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Three-fifth of articles sold at 16% profit. 

The remaining sold at the cost price.

**Concept used:**

Gain percentage = (Profit / cost price) × 100

**Calculation:**

Let, total number of article be 50, and cost price of each article be Rs 100.

Total cost price = 50 × 100 = Rs. 5000

So, 3/5 of total article = 50 × 3 / 5 = 30

So, SP of 30 articles = 116 × 30 = Rs. 3480

Remaining article = 50 - 30 = 20

So, SP of the remaining 20 articles = 100 × 20

⇒ Rs 2000

Total SP = 3480 + 2000 = Rs. 5480

Total profit = 5480 - 5000 = Rs. 480

So, profit percentage = (480 / 5000) × 100

⇒ 48 / 5 %

⇒ 9 (3)/(5) %

**∴ The gain earned in the whole transaction is 9 (3)/(5) ****%.**

questions.question: If (x - 3) is the HCF of x² – 5x + 6 and x² + mx + 12, then what is the value of m?
questions.solution:
**Concept used:**

(x - 3) is the HCF of x2 – 5x + 6 and x2 + mx + 12,

So, (x2 + mx + 12) is divisible by (x - 3).

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

⇒ x - 3 = 0

⇒ x = 3

Putting x = 3 in the equation below,

⇒ x2 + mx + 12 = 0

⇒ 9 +3m + 12 = 0

⇒ 3m = -21

⇒ m = -7

**∴ The value of m is -7.**

questions.question: What is the average of the prime numbers between 20 and 50?
questions.solution:
**Formula:**

Average = Sum / Total number

**Calculation:**

The prime numbers between 20 and 50 is 23, 29, 31, 37, 41, 43, 47

Total number of prime numbers = 7

Sum of the prime numbers between 20 and 50 

⇒ 23 + 29 + 31 + 37 + 41 + 43 + 47

⇒ 251

So, average of the numbers = 251 / 7 = 35.857

**∴ The average is 35.857.**

questions.question: In a restaurant, 40% customers had a non-vegetarian lunch, 52% had a vegetarian lunch, and 20% had both types of lunches. If 125 customers were present, how many did NOT eat either type of lunch?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total customers = 125

Non-vegetarian lunch = 40% of customers 

Vegetarian lunch = 52% of customers

Both type of lunches = 20% of customers

**Formula:**

If non-vegetarian lunch customer is a%, vegetarian lunch customer is b% and customers who had both types of lunches are c%

Didn't eat either type of lunch = 100 - (a + b - c) %

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

Customers didn't eat either type of lunch 

⇒ 100 - ( 40 + 52 - 20)

⇒ 100 - 72 = 28%

Now,

100 % = 125

So, 28% = (125 / 100) × 28

⇒ (5 / 4) × 28 = 35

**∴ Customers did NOT eat either type of lunch is 35.**

questions.question: Three numbers are in the ratio 2 : 3 : 5 and the sum of their cubes is 34560. What is the second number?

Ratio of three numbers = 2 : 3 : 5 

Sum of their cubes = 34560

⇒ (2x)3 + (3x)3 + (5x)3 = 34560

⇒ 160x³ = 34560

⇒ x = 6

So, 3x = 18

∴ The second number is 18.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of three numbers = 2 : 3 : 5 

Sum of their cubes = 34560

**Calculation:**

Let, the numbers are 2x, 3x, and 5x respectively.

According to the question,

⇒ (2x)³ + (3x)³ + (5x)³ = 34560

⇒ 8x³ + 27x³+ 125x³ = 34560

⇒ 160x³ = 34560

⇒ 16x³ = 3456

⇒ x³ = 216

⇒ x = 6

So, the 2nd number = 3 × 6 = 18

**∴ The second number is 18.**

questions.question: The perimeter of a rhombus is 148 cm and one of its diagonals is 70 cm. The area (in cm²) of the rhombus is:

One of its diagonals = 70 cm

The area of the rhombus = (1 / 2) × Multiplication of the two diagonals

Half of the other diagonal,

⇒ sqrt {(37)² - (35)²} 

⇒ sqrt{(37 + 35) (37 - 35)} 

⇒ sqrt{(72 × 2)} = √ 144 = 12 cm

Other diagonal = 2 × 12 = 24 cm

So, area = 1/2 (70 × 24) = 840 cm². 

**∴ The area of the rhombus is 840 cm2**

questions.question: Ramu had borrowed ₹20,000 from a bank at simple interest, and after 5 years he repaid an amount of ₹25,000 to the bank. What was the rate of interest per year?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Borrowed amount at SI = Rs. 20,000 

After 5 years, repaid amount = Rs. 25,000

**Concept used:**

Rate of interest = (Interest in 1 yr / Principal) × 100

**Calculation:**

SI earned in 5 years = (25,000 - 20,000) = Rs. 5000

SI earned in 1 year = 5000 / 5 = Rs 1000

Now, Rate of interest = (1000 / 20000) × 100 = 5%

**∴ Rate of interest is 5%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 Simple interest = (Principal × rate of interest × time) / 100

questions.question: What is the number which when divided by 39, 52 and 60 leaves the remainders 30, 43 and 51, respectively?
questions.solution:
**Concept used:**

If the gap between each divisor and its remainder is equal,

the number = LCM - The equal gap

**Calculation:**

The gaps are:

39 - 30 = 9, 52 - 43 = 9 and 60 - 51 = 9

So, the LCM of 39, 52 and 60 = 780

So, the number = 780 - 9 = 771

**∴ The number is 771.**
